FormulaExpression: IF(COUNTQUERY("SELECT id,%vlocity_namespace%__OrderId__c,%vlocity_namespace%__PromotionId__r.name  from %vlocity_namespace%__OrderAppliedPromotion__c where %vlocity_namespace%__PromotionId__r.CAT_Type__c = 'TodoClaro' and %vlocity_namespace%__PromotionId__r.name <> 'Claro video sin consumo de datos' and %vlocity_namespace%__OrderId__c = '{0}'", orderId) > 0, "CCV", "")
